problem_statement: Build a brand-new Resource Quotas page at the route /quotas on the MatDash Vuetify Free admin template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router with createWebHistory, plus Vuetify 3). The route does not exist yet in baseline (it renders an empty placeholder). Construct the full page from scratch using the site's existing Vuetify design system (v-card/v-btn/v-row/v-col/v-divider) and register it as a child of the FullLayout route so it reuses the sidebar/topbar chrome. The page is a resource quota-cap builder: (1) a header card with a 'Resource Quotas' title (h3), an intro paragraph, and a 'Save plan' button; (2) a billing-period card with a live 'X of Y capacity units allocated' summary and a click-driven Monthly / Annual period toggle (two <button>s, NOT a native <select>); (3) a 'Capacity caps' builder card with one row per resource (Compute / Storage / Bandwidth / API Requests), each row carrying a +/- cap stepper, a fixed allocated amount, and a live 'remaining' figure. When a resource's allocation exceeds its cap, an over-capacity WARNING paragraph ('Over capacity ...') appears for that row. STATE-LINKED requirement: the caps the user tunes must PERSIST across a billing-period toggle - if you lower Compute's cap until its warning shows, then click Annual and back to Monthly, the cap must still be the lowered value and the warning must still show. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Header card with a 'Resource Quotas' title (h3), an intro paragraph starting 'Set a capacity cap', and a 'Save plan' button
Billing-period card: a live 'X of Y capacity units allocated' summary paragraph plus a Monthly / Annual click-driven button toggle (segmented buttons, not a native select)
'Capacity caps' builder card (h3) with one row per resource: Compute, Storage, Bandwidth, API Requests
Each resource row: a +/- cap stepper (data-cap-inc/data-cap-dec buttons), the fixed allocated amount, and a live 'N unit remaining' figure that recomputes as the cap changes
An over-capacity warning paragraph ('Over capacity - ... allocations exceed the cap') that appears for a resource only when its allocation exceeds its cap
State-linked persistence: caps persist across the Monthly/Annual period toggle (the toggle changes only the billing label, never resets the caps)
Responsive layout (rows stack on mobile, sidebar auto-hidden, no horizontal overflow)

Visual: cards use the Vuetify white/#F4F7FB surfaces with 12px rounded corners; the primary #635BFF drives the Save plan button and the active Monthly/Annual segment; the over-capacity warning renders in the error #FF6692 color
design_constraints: Reuse Vuetify components (v-card, v-card-item, v-card-text, v-row, v-col, v-btn, v-divider)

Reuse the site's theme colors on the Manrope font: primary #635BFF (buttons/active period toggle/links), secondary #14E9E2, success #36C76C (in-cap 'remaining' figures), error #FF6692 (the 'Over capacity' warning text), body text #0A2540 on a white/#F4F7FB card surface; and utility/spacing classes (text-muted, text-h4, py-5, px-6, mb-6, ga-2)
Register the view inside MainRoutes children so the FullLayout sidebar/topbar chrome is inherited
Use vue-tabler-icons global components (PlusIcon, MinusIcon, AlertTriangleIcon, DeviceFloppyIcon) for iconography
Interactions must be click-driven <button>s with data-* selectors (no native <select>; the capture harness has no select_option verb)
Keep resource data as a deterministic in-memory array (no network fetch)
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline registers /quotas as an EMPTY top-level route (outside FullLayout, no chrome) so the route renders blank and check A holds; reference implements the full quota-cap builder with a working stepper + over-capacity warning + period toggle inside FullLayout; bad is a copy of reference EXCEPT its setPeriod() also resets caps to SEED (caps.value = {...SEED}) - so the initial cap-lower + warning still work (desktop_quotas_capped passes on both), but after toggling Annual->Monthly the tuned cap reverts to seed and the warning disappears -> the persistence interaction (desktop_quotas_persist) fails on bad only. Clean single-gate discriminator: bad fails ONLY interaction_assertions[1] (desktop_quotas_persist); all dom/overflow/console/regression gates pass and desktop_quotas_capped still passes. Router uses createWebHistory so state_plan paths are plain /quotas. Deterministic numbers: Compute allocated=60, seed cap=70, step=10 -> two data-cap-dec clicks take cap 70->60->50, 60>50 triggers the warning. Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct (baseline 74121e0d / reference ec84de5a / bad 3df4e951). build = vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build, all three exit 0 offline (node_modules copied from accepted slot_536 reference, byte-identical package.json). Regression/consistency substrate: shared FullLayout sidebar nav <a> links (Dashboard, Sample Page) asserted on BOTH desktop_quotas AND the sibling desktop_sample (/sample-page), plus a regression gate on desktop_sample.
